title: Green Oranges
subtitle: You can pluck that green orange as easily as you take her life.

trails.title: The Door with Wet Paint
trails.description:
The paint on this door has yet to dry. The black paint is really out of place, and it is obvious that the original color was bright orange. You knocked but there was no response.
A sign that read "Not Yet" was placed on the door.

content.text:
Who killed the Snowy Dove?
I, said the cricket.
With my heart and musket I killed the Snowy Dove.

Who saw her die?
I, said the owner of the suitcase,
With my vision and sight,
I saw her die.

Who dug her grave?
I, said the cricket.
With my pick and spade,
I dug her grave.

Who'll make her shroud?
I, said the owner of the suitcase,
With my little suitcase,
I'll make her shroud.

items.text: Green Oranges

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: F**k ... It hurts …

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Can you stand up, Miss Schneider? Both your right hand and left leg are injured.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Arcana walks to Schneider.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Get lost! Don't touch my gun!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Rotten roots, croaking toads ... You jerk!!

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Lady Vertin, what do you think of her pistol?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... A great one.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Exactly. Which was improved by our finest wandmaker—Druvis III.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Take this.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I don't need it!

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: And end her life.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Why? I've decided to join you!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The three questions are all done. It's already ... already enough!

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Hmm, indeed.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: It is a mission, a new mission showing our welcome to thee.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Thou hast no right to refuse. Complying is thy only choice.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Yet, Lady Vertin liketh not this. Then nay it is.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Have an orange.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Orange?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Why oranges here ...?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Stop running! You orange thief!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Schneider? How did you become ... so young ...?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Huh? Your clothes. ... Are you from the downtown?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Ah ... I see. You are the friend that my sis said helping us pick oranges.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Come with me. We have to hurry up. Uncle Cannavale is going to transport the oranges to town tonight!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Where ... where am I?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Don't be afraid. You can cut the oranges when you climb there. I'll grab you tight!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The orange tree feels so real—the warm breeze, the familiar scent ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... I'm here to pick oranges.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Eh hey.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Uggh ... uggh ... huh  ... huh ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: My lord, it's not fair. You're shooting someone seriously injured ... Oh ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Wake up! Come to your senses!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ah, thank you for wiping the mud off my face.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Are you really here to help us pick oranges? You don't look very skilled. Or is all the city people like that?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Who says I'm not skilled? Observe. Let me pick up that big orange at the top for you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Just climb up here, take a small jump ... then I'll get it ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Hey! I got it!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Uggh ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Huh ... So it feels like this ... to be shot by my own bullet ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: It's not over yet ... my lord. Then ... don't blame me for giving no mercy ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Pap! Pap! Pap!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Your back is bloody red ...  Don't you feel the pain?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: That son of a b***h! What the hell did she show you?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Vertin's back ... such a huge scar on her back. ... How?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Interesting. Interesting. Lines. The moon, The eye. What is it?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Hey! I got it!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: How did you fall from the tree? Your back is bleeding.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I ... I think I just saw a critter ... Didn't watch my step when driving it away.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Critter ... ahh, I know it. That's the little animal that didn't take the ark, right? I often find them in the bushes!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You often see strange creatures ... Are you also an arcanist?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: I'm ... umm ...

items.speaker: Critters
items.text: *appear*

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ah, the critters are making trouble now! Wait a minute. I will deal with them soon.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Here you are.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: It's the big orange. Thank you for helping us. Let's have it together! I want to hear the story about the world outside!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In the future ... will you also come to town, Schneider?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: I ... I have no idea. I've never left here. But my uncles have gone to the United States many years ago.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: My family would also like to go. I heard that ... it's completely different from here.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: It's the real new world.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: There are wonders. Full measure of the blessing will be given. Sins will be forgiven. The god there ... loves the world.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Umm? Why don't you eat, Miss Vertin?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I don't feel like it.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I've been wondering ... don't you think this orange ... tastes bitter?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Why not shoot? My lord ... huh ... just one last shot. ... Why did you stop! Why!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Don't I deserve the right to ... die fast?!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Or did God finally forgive me. ... He allowed me ... to stay alive!!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Schneider?! Why are you covered in blood ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The pistol ... No, no, no! Don't come over!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is the final chance.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: One shall fall, one shall stand.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Schneider dashes to Vertin, her chest bumping into the quivering pistol.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Pap!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Schneider?! Why ...!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: My lord ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: ... Not now.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm sorry.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Oops, right in the heart.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Acccidently, though, our new member is quite the sharpshooter.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Where are you going? Miss Druvis.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: To where I go.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: This body, thou hast any idea? Miss Druvis.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Send her back to where she belongs.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: So that they know Miss Vertin's choice.
TO BE CONTINUED…
